label: 2-O-(6-phospho-alpha-D-mannosyl)-D-glycerate
rows: An organophosphate oxoanion derived from 2-O-(6-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl)-D-glyceric acid by removal of the two protons from the phosphate group and the proton from the carboxylic acid group.

label: water
rows: An oxygen hydride consisting of an oxygen atom that is covalently bonded to two hydrogen atoms

label: D-mannopyranose 6-phosphate(2-)
rows: A <small>D</small>-hexopyranose 6-phosphate(2−) that is the dianion of <small>D</small>-mannopyranose 6-phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate function.

label: D-glycerate
rows: A glycerate that is the conjugate base of <small>D</small>-glyceric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

label: ATP(4-)
rows: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) obtained by global deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of ATP; major species present at pH 7.3.

label: ADP(3-)
rows: A nucleoside 5'-diphosphate(3−) arising from deprotonation of all three diphosphate OH groups of adenosine 5'-diphosphate (ADP); major species present at pH 7.3.

label: hydron
rows: The general name for the hydrogen nucleus, to be used without regard to the hydrogen nuclear mass (either for hydrogen in its natural abundance or where it is not desired to distinguish between the isotopes).

label: 2-phosphonato-D-glycerate(3-)
rows: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH and carboxy groups of 2-phospho-<small>D</small>-glyceric acid; major species at pH 7.3.

label: phosphonatoenolpyruvate
rows: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate groups of phosphoenolpyruvic acid.

label: pyruvate
rows: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of pyruvic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

label: alpha-D-mannose 6-phosphate(2-)
rows: Dianion of α-<small>D</small>-mannose 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

label: 2-oxoglutarate(2-)
rows: An oxo dicarboxylate obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 2-oxoglutaric acid.

label: divalent metal cation
rows: A metal cation with a valence of two.

label: D-glucarate(2-)
rows: Dicarboxylate anion of <small>D</small>-glucaric acid; major species at pH 7.3.

label: galactarate(2-)
rows: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that is the conjugate base of galactarate(1−).

label: tetra-mu3-sulfido-tetrairon
rows: An Fe<small><sub>4</sub></small>S<small><sub>4</sub></small> iron-sulfur cluster in which each sulfur is attached to three of the iron atoms.

label: cytoplasm
rows: The contents of a cell excluding the plasma membrane and nucleus, but including other subcellular structures.

label: plasma membrane
rows: The membrane surrounding a cell that separates the cell from its external environment. It consists of a phospholipid bilayer and associated proteins.

label: nucleoid
rows: The region of a virus, bacterial cell, mitochondrion or chloroplast to which the nucleic acid is confined.
